configurations.name: example
configurations.comment: Run via bun --cwd apps/example (single React copy), but prepend homebrew Node so vite's shebang uses v23, not the default v12 on PATH.
runtimeArgs: PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH exec bun run --cwd apps/example dev

configurations.name: api
configurations.comment: Hono mock CRUD backend on port 9000. Prepend homebrew Node so nodemon/tsx use v23, not the default v12 on PATH.
runtimeArgs: PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH exec bun run --cwd apps/api dev

configurations.name: studio-alt
configurations.comment: Same as studio on a fallback port, for when another session holds 3300.

configurations.name: studio-b
configurations.comment: Second fallback, for when other sessions hold 3300 and 3311.

configurations.name: demo
configurations.comment: The demo app (GummyApp over gummy/projects/book-shop/), port 3400. Needs demo-api and a built packages/ui.
runtimeArgs: PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH exec bun run --cwd demo app

configurations.name: demo-api
configurations.comment: The Book shop mock API (demo/api, Hono on Bun), port 9100.

configurations.name: demo-studio
configurations.comment: `gummy studio` over demo/gummy (the Book shop workspace), port 3398 — edits rewrite demo/gummy/projects/book-shop/.

configurations.name: demo-clerk
configurations.comment: A second demo app signed in as the clerk (VITE_AUTH_MOCK_EMAIL overrides demo/.env), port 3401 — the intro video's role scene.
runtimeArgs: cd demo && PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH VITE_AUTH_MOCK_EMAIL=pimchanok_s@banpu.co.th exec bun x vite --port 3401 --strictPort
